name: SST Open-Source Serverless Framework
free_limit: MIT-licensed SST CLI and TypeScript components for building and deploying serverless/full-stack apps on your own cloud infrastructure; no SST CLI usage quota.
watch_out: SST software is free, not hosted compute. AWS/Cloudflare and other provider resources, storage, networking and optional SST Console usage can incur charges; provider accounts and billing may be required. License applies to the framework, not third-party infrastructure.
